name: Camp Nonesuch
description_short: Day camp run by The Rivers School on 13 wooded acres beside Nonesuch Pond, on the Natick and Weston line. Campers pick their own activities for each two week session, from boating and swimming to crafts, woodworking, drama and team sports.
swim_waterfront_notes: American Red Cross swim instruction on Nonesuch Pond. Kayaking is limited to campers age 10 and up who pass the camp swim test.
refund_policy_summary: A deposit of $50 per camper per week is due at registration and is credited to tuition; it is non-refundable. Reducing enrollment after May 15 costs a $50 change fee.
